title: Choir and Oath Anew
author: Theo Dunmore
blurb: Rosalind Dravenmoor, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
